item.title: Iran prepared to withstand naval blockade: VP Aref
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref says that the country is not concerned about a US-imposed naval blockade, pointing to a significant increase in the unloading and clearance of essential goods through its northern and other non-southern borders.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86332088/Iran-prepared-to-withstand-naval-blockade-VP-Aref

Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref says that the country is not concerned about a US-imposed naval blockade, pointing to a significant increase in the unloading and clearance of essential goods through its northern and other non-southern borders.

item.title: Iran warns against weaponization of AI for aggression and escalation of wars
item.description: New York, IRNA — Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations in New York, Gholamhossein Darzi, has warned that the weaponization of artificial intelligence for aggression and escalation of conflicts raises serious concerns, citing the US and Israeli regime’s wars against Iran in June 2025 and February 2026.
